newsitem.title: FINLAND: OUTOKUMPU BLAST HALTS OUTPUT,INJURES THREE.
newsitem.headline: OUTOKUMPU BLAST HALTS OUTPUT,INJURES THREE.

text.p: Finnish mining and metals group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement received on Monday that an explosion over the weekend at its Harjavalta Metals Oy unit injured three employees and halted copper and nickel output.
"According to preliminary estimates the damages will amount to several tens of millions of Finnish markka," Outokumpu said.
Three employees were injured, two of them seriously, in the Sunday morning explosion at the Harjavalta plant's smelter department, Outokumpu said.
The blast was apparently caused by a water leakage in the electric nickel slag furnace, it said.

The stoppage in nickel production would be longer than the halt in copper output, and the length of the stoppage and effect on total nickel production would be evaluated in the next few days, Outokumpu said.
